theorem zero_sum_bound {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) (δ : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0)
    (hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, χ.LFunction ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2) (T : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ T, (multRect χ T u : ℂ) * (Gr u δ 0 * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      E0b N + √x * E1b N T0 + x * E2b N T0 δ :=

note: Constants reproduced with c = 0.1065: 1.487 = 0.995/(2πc), 2.194 = 0.995/(40c²), 2.566 = 0.995·0.117/(4c²). Erratum: The last step of (9.54) needs 1.487 + 2.566(1 + 1/log(T₀/π|δ|))|δ|/T₀ ≤ 1.578, i.e. T₀ ≥ 39.35|δ|, which follows from the 2013 hypothesis T₀ ≥ 4π²|δ| cited after (9.54) (coefficient 1.5777) but not from Lemma 9.3.1's T₀ ≥ max(10π|δ|, 50) (coefficient 1.6042) (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_9_54.py`).
